grammar.0.note: In everyday speech use the Perfekt; the Präteritum for narrating stories and events; the Plusquamperfekt for earlier events.
grammar.1.note: hätte / wäre + Partizip II. To express unreal conditions and regret about the past.
grammar.2.note: Expressing gratitude strengthens relationships. In an email: „Herzlichen Dank für Ihre Hilfe.“
